screens.text:
OPERATOR, now that you have excreted waste, decontaminated yourself, and ingested nutrients,
+we will prepare for the EXCURSION.
+Reminder: Everything you do aboard any REC-7 vessel is recorded.
+The scheduled EXCURSION will begin now.

Please proceed to the READY ROOM.

tips.text: This is your TRM-CUFF Map. The yellow circle indicates your current position.
Dark rooms have not been explored.
If a Dark Room is named, you might know what to expect, but you have not explored it.
These lines indicate doors or other passages.
Lock symbols mean the door is locked, and you will need a KEYCARD to open it.
Click on the room you wish to move to. If there is an accessible passage, you will move there.

end.move_prompt: Please proceed to the READY ROOM.

screens.heading: READY ROOM
screens.text:
The Ready Room is dimly lit from a row of lights around the edges of the ceiling. A large [act=window]WINDOW[/act] dominates the north side of the room. A ship looms in empty space outside, still and silent.

A row of four [act=locker]LOCKERS[/act] line the wall. You can't seem to remember which one is yours.

A set of cabinets in the corner hosts what you recognize as a [act=coffee]COFFEE POT[/act]. Metal cups hang from hooks along the wall behind it.

locker.title: LOCKER
locker.text:
The locker is in front of you.

The suit is the sensible thing to take. The lantern is light.

A keycard hangs on a hook inside.

items.label: SUIT
items.detail: Pressure suit. Put it on before you go outside.

search.text: Searching the locker will take 1 hr. Are you sure?

coffee.title: COFFEE POT
coffee.text: The coffee pot is empty and cold. Surely there are supplies in the cabinets above. Maybe you could even find a thermos. Do you want to brew coffee?

window.text:
You step over to the window and look outside. Space has never seemed so--dark. Twinkling pinpricks of light shine from distant stars, but they are few and far between. Blue and purple wisps of a nearby nebulae streak one corner of the view.

The ship dominates the center, lit by spotlights from the [act=abeyance]RSV ABEYANCE[/act]. It sits motionless in the gloom, like a the corpse of a hulking giant. A chill creeps down your spine. What horrors await?

abeyance.text: RSV ABEYANCE - The RSV ABEYANCE is small Rec-7 vessel designed for deep space travel. Crewed by four Rec-7 OPERATORS, the ship has cryopod stasis chambers for each one. Crewmates rarely see each other, if ever, as only one crewman is needed per excursion. The ABEYANCE is piloted and operated by AI. Crew may be in stasis for months or years at a time, only to be waked when the ship reaches a mission destination.

screens.heading: STASIS-3
screens.text:
STASIS-3 is quiet. Your cryopod stands open and empty, its lid raised, frost still melting on the glass.

There is nothing more for you here.
